name: Paper Tales
summary: Fantasy card-drafting kingdom builder where players draft and deploy units and buildings over four ages to earn legend points.
rules_text: Each game lasts 4 turns of 6 simultaneous phases. Setup: shuffle 81 Unit cards, give each player 3 Gold, 5 Building cards (Town, Tavern, Mine, Temple, Barracks), and score marker. Recruitment: deal 5 Unit cards to each player. Draft 1 and pass remainder left on turns 1 and 3, right on 2 and 4, until each has 5. One unplayed card may be kept facedown for next turn. Deployment: players may discard or rearrange existing Units, then secretly place new Units on up to 4 spots (2 Front, 2 Back, unlockable 5th) and reveal, paying Gold costs. Units kept over turns are not repaid. Income phase grants 2 Gold plus abilities. Construction: using persistent resource icons produced by cards in play and paying 2 Gold per existing Building, build one Building level 1 or directly level 2, or upgrade. War: Front row strength summed and compared to each neighbor; winning or tying each comparison yields 3 Legend Points. Aging discards old Units. Most points wins.
rating_reason: Card drafting game for 2-5, collection and points
